targets.queryText:
SELECT
  binZ AS "MCS",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 1 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 2 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 3 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 4 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 4",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 5 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 5",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 6 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 6",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 7 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 7",
  MAX(CASE WHEN binX = 8 THEN measure_value END) AS "RI 8"
FROM
  KPM_MeasRecord
WHERE
  meas_name = 'CARR.PDSCHMCSDist' AND
  binY = 1 AND -- Filtering for MCS Table 1
  tstamp = (SELECT MAX(tstamp) FROM KPM_MeasRecord WHERE meas_name = 'CARR.PDSCHMCSDist')
GROUP BY
  binZ
ORDER BY
  binZ

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  datetime(tstamp / 1000000, 'unixepoch', '+3 hours') AS event_time,
  mcc,
  mnc,
  nb_id,
  cu_du_id,
  ran_cfg_struct,
  payload
FROM CCC_IND
ORDER BY tstamp DESC
LIMIT 100;
targets.rawQueryText:

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  CAST(tstamp / 1000000 AS INTEGER) AS "time",
  'nb_id=' || CAST(nb_id AS TEXT) AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS indications
FROM CCC_IND
WHERE CAST(tstamp / 1000000 AS INTEGER) >= $__from / 1000
  AND CAST(tstamp / 1000000 AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "time" ASC;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  CAST(tstamp / 1000000 AS INTEGER) AS "time",
  'nb_id=' || CAST(nb_id AS TEXT) AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS indications
FROM CCC_IND
WHERE CAST(tstamp / 1000000 AS INTEGER) >= $__from / 1000
  AND CAST(tstamp / 1000000 AS INTEGER) <= $__to / 1000
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY "time" ASC;

targets.queryText:
SELECT
  ran_cfg_struct,
  mcc,
  mnc,
  nb_id,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  datetime(MAX(tstamp) / 1000000, 'unixepoch', '+3 hours') AS last_seen
FROM CCC_IND
GROUP BY ran_cfg_struct, mcc, mnc, nb_id
ORDER BY MAX(tstamp) DESC;
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  ran_cfg_struct,
  mcc,
  mnc,
  nb_id,
  COUNT(*) AS count,
  datetime(MAX(tstamp) / 1000000, 'unixepoch', '+3 hours') AS last_seen
FROM CCC_IND
GROUP BY ran_cfg_struct, mcc, mnc, nb_id
ORDER BY MAX(tstamp) DESC;
